data.description: Motivated Seller | Investment Opportunity | Open View
data.display_address: Azizi Venice 9, Azizi Venice, Dubai South (Dubai World Central), Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this spacious 2-bedroom apartment situated on a high floor in Azizi Venice, one of Dubai South’s most anticipated waterfront master communities. This corner unit enjoys added privacy, abundant natural light, and open views, making it one of the most sought-after layouts within the development.

The apartment boasts a thoughtfully planned layout with expansive living and dining areas, perfectly suited for comfortable day-to-day living. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance the sense of space and brightness throughout, while the elevated floor offers a more peaceful and refined living environment.

Azizi Venice is envisioned as a vibrant lifestyle destination inspired by European waterfront living. Residents will enjoy crystal lagoons, scenic promenades, retail and dining outlets, landscaped areas, and a wide range of leisure amenities, all within a fully integrated community. Strategically located in Dubai South, the project offers excellent connectivity to major highways, Al Maktoum International Airport, and key commercial hubs.

This property is an excellent choice for end users seeking a contemporary waterfront home, as well as investors looking to capitalize on strong long-term growth potential in one of Dubai’s fastest-developing areas.
